subject: alternative of locator() function for shiny web apps

messages.author: 3a5379f8bfb2dfdd
messages.subject: alternative of locator() function for shiny web apps
parts:
Hello Every body,
I am trying to develop some math practice for children in R. What I am doing is
1. Generate problem and display in graphic interface
2. I stop here using the function  " locator(1) ", so that student can work the problem, I can even use tcltk dialog box (works fine).
3. When student finish their work, they can click anywhere in the screen which unlocks the screen and start running the further code.
4. Now they can see the answer and check whether they are right or wrong
This locator(1) function perfectly works on graphical mode,

but now I am trying to browse my work as "Web Apps" this locator(1) (not even tcltk dialog box)  function does not work in  shiny web apps.
could any body kindly suggest me any alternatives,

Thank you

Sincerely,

Indra

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: alternative of locator() function for shiny web apps

Perhaps an actionButton in combination with observe?

http://www.inside-r.org/packages/cran/shiny/docs/actionButton

observe({
  if(is.null(input$mybutton) || input$mybutton == 0) return()

  # run other code when button is pressed

})
